Why: LTB4 recruits neutrophils and sensitises nociceptors
Note: LTB4 lowers the nociceptive threshold through neutrophils; BLT1 is needed for inflammatory arthritis, and BLT1 and LTA4H are raised in OA cartilage. BLT2 is protective in other tissues (Yokomizo 2015), a difference the block does not draw.
Evidence: pain model (rat), arthritis model (mouse), human OA cartilage
